ICS 91.060.30CED 05New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard specifies requirements of stone-polymer composite (SPC) flooring tiles and planks. It includes tiles and planks with or without a locking system that are printed/surface decorated, protected by a wearing layer, and have a backing layer when required.2. REFERENCESThe following standards contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of the standard indicated below:3464 : 1986 Methods of test for plastic flooring and wall tiles (second revision)9766 : 1992 Flexible PVC compounds - Specification (first revision)15061 : 2002 Automotive vehicles - Flammability requirements
